rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the tight-binding model (Eq. 3) and Boltzmann transport (Eqs. 2, 4), confirming the headline claim of |SP|=1 orthogonal spin-polarized transport in the ridge limit. However, major paper claims were deliberately scoped out: DFT validation of the candidate material Mg₂Mo₂(PO₅)₂, the layer degree of freedom and P(k) that constitutes the 'L' in RSLC, the electric-field switchability mechanism, and the relativistic Hall effect. Since RSLC is the paper's central novelty and only the RS (ridge-spin) part was verified while the L (layer) coupling was not independently computed, this constitutes a partial replication of the theoretical framework rather than full validation.
